comment: The fire pole (0.84887): a planks fence three posts high, a hay bale on it cased in four cobblestone covers (15; one in each cell beside the hay, against it: wood round a fire that never burns it looked wrong) and a fifth under it (lying in the top post's cell, round the post: `covers`, [x, y, z, id, variant], 113 = SHAPE_COVER + top), and a fire on the hay. A structure's fire on hay never spreads, never burns the hay and never goes out (FIRE_ETERNAL, fireStamped in 53-storms.js). The posts are oak planks (5); spawn.replace gives them the planks of the trees where it stands, by biome: the full name first (Cold Plains), then its base name (a Deep Birch Forest is a Birch Forest, the Deep Beach a Beach). Cells: [x, y, z, id, variant]; fence 64 = SHAPE_FENCE, covers 114-117 = SHAPE_COVER + side (-X, +X, -Z, +Z), fire 179 variant 1 = eternal.
